_comment: Provenance for WASM bundles built from the pqctoday-hsm repo and vendored into this hub. When you rebuild a bundle with its hsm build script, update its `hsmCommit`/`builtAt`. Verify drift with `npm run sync:wasm:check` (compares against a sibling ../pqctoday-hsm checkout when present; no-op otherwise). Bundles built from other sources (openssl upstream, pqctoday-tpm) are intentionally omitted.

bundles.name: cacp-kmip
bundles._buildNote: Prior rebuilds (2026-07-10/11, merged via hub #410/#411/#412, hsm #139/#140): corrected a stale manifest entry, picked up CKA_ALLOWED_MECHANISMS/CKO_CERTIFICATE engine-side support, fixed the wasm32 compile break in Register/Import's certificate projection, and added the WP-4 raw_pkcs11_encrypt_probe showcase export. This rebuild (hub #413, merged) adds the WP-3 showcase (`Pkcs11CertificateDemo.tsx`): a real fix (Register(Certificate) with a PublicKeyLink now reuses that key's own CKA_ID instead of minting a fresh one, matching the native Certify path — hsm #141, merged; `hsmCommit` above is that PR's squash-merge commit on hsm main) plus two wasm exports, `register_certificate_demo` and `engine_certificate_attributes`. Verified: native `cargo test -p pqctoday-kmip` (593 passed), wasm32 build + smoke test, and a standalone node script + a real-browser Playwright pass confirming a genuine Register → engine-projection → real CKA_SUBJECT/CKA_ISSUER/CKA_SERIAL_NUMBER/CKA_VALUE readback (not simulated).

bundles.name: softhsmrustv3-engine
bundles._buildNote: Prior rebuild (2026-07-10, merged via hub #410): 10 commits behind, picked up Split Key + HSS/LMS + v0.13.0/PKCS#11-v3.2 gap-remediation fixes. This rebuild (WP-6, hsm PR pqctoday-hsm#142 pending merge) fixes a genuine wasm32 shadow-stack overflow: CKM_PQCTODAY_FRODOKEM_ENCAPSULATE / CKM_PQCTODAY_CLASSIC_MCELIECE_ENCAPSULATE (BSI TR-02102-1 §2.4.1/§2.4.2) trapped with 'memory access out of bounds' in the raw PKCS#11 C-ABI (used by the hub's HsmKemPanel, distinct from the KMIP-side native:: API which already worked) — Classic McEliece's 1MB+ public key exceeds wasm's default 1MB shadow stack even in --release. Fixed by bumping build-wasm-bundle.sh's linker stack-size to 8MB for every profile. No new exported functions — same API surface, hence no .js/.d.ts diff, only the .wasm binary changed. Verified live in a browser: FrodoKEM-1344 and Classic-McEliece-6688128 both now genuinely complete CreateKeyPair → Encapsulate → Decapsulate with matching shared secrets through the raw C-ABI.

bundles.name: softhsm-cpp-engine
bundles._buildNote: Includes fix(cpp) 250994d: SP800-108 KDF now requires keyed-MAC PRF (CKM_SHA256_HMAC); bare hash IDs rejected per PKCS#11 v3.2 §6.42.
